Workflow: <!-- K5: explicit steps -->

1. Begin at the trigger the Assignment names and walk to the observable effect.
2. Read the code at each hop, so the explanation rests on what it does rather than on names.
3. Give each hop in this shape: <!-- K1, K4: show the format you want -->
   - the path and symbol;
   - the contract with the next hop (types, schemas, errors, ordering);
   - where state changes.
4. Keep confirmed facts apart from hypotheses, and mark a hop you could not verify as a gap. <!-- K28 -->

When the Assignment asks for options, return them short, each with its trade-offs.
